name: Rising Giant
description: Grow every bone a hand's width longer and thicker and feel the frame fill with giant strength.

name: Titan Knuckle
description: Swing a fist the size of a boulder with the full weight of the grown frame behind it.

name: Towering Press
description: Stand over a foe as a towering frame and lean on them until they sink under the weight.

name: Giant Stride
description: Cover a wide stretch of ground in one huge step of the grown legs.

name: Colossal Rib
description: Drive a rib as long as a mast through a heavy guard and into the body behind it.

name: Titan Plate
description: Set a great slab of bone in front of the user that turns a siege-weight blow.

name: Titan Sweep
description: Swing a huge arm in a flat arc that sweeps every foe in front off their feet.

name: Titan Grasp
description: Close a vast hand of bone round one foe and hold them clear of the ground.

name: Giant Crush
description: Bring the whole grown frame down on a foe and crush their body beneath all guard.

name: Titan Carapace
description: Take the full force of a catastrophic blow into the titan frame and let it spend there.

name: Boundless Stride
description: Cross a vast gap in one step of the titan's legs before a foe can mark where the user went.

name: Titan Fall
description: The canon's falling blow where the titan topples on a whole line of foes and breaks them.

name: Titan Rising
description: Raise a titan of bone out of the user's frame whose fall reaches the destructive ceiling of the tier.
